props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Missing parts start empty.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole address after every edit.

props.name: countries
props.description: The countries offered, in order. Defaults to a short list with local labels.

props.name: defaultCountry
props.description: Country used when the value names none.

props.name: onSuggest
props.description: Called as the first line is typed, from three characters. Return suggestions from your address provider; picking one fills the fields. Omit for plain fields.

props.name: name
props.description: Prefix for the `name` of each input, so the address submits with a form: `shipping` gives `shipping-city`.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the address, the city and the postal code as required.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the fields.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hide the legend visually, keeping it for assistive tech.
